name: Vega Castañeda
role: Chemical and biological agent specialist — poisoner
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Vega Castañeda is average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 32, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She taught herself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know her best. She works as a poisoner out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Vega Castañeda lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Ihaia Sorokin-Gyasi has been doubling fees to clients and pocketing the difference. The fixer who handles their contracts doesn't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
Repeats the last thing someone said back to them before responding — processing or intimidation
example_lines: "The best poison is the one nobody tests for."
"Patience, precision, and an understanding of human biology. Everything else is optional."

story_hooks: Ihaia Sorokin-Gyasi discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Ihaia Sorokin-Gyasi intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
A Tier 4 executive offers Ihaia Sorokin-Gyasi a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: Ihaia Sorokin-Gyasi represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio. Thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American (62.6%) with significant Middle Eastern (22.0%) and Sub-Saharan African (15.4%) admixture — a distinctly warm-toned diaspora blend reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora of 2226. The genetic confluence produces warm golden-brown skin with subtle olive undertones, defined cheekbones with gentle fullness, and strong Mediterranean-influenced facial structure
physical_description.build: Lean and compact, economical muscle distribution without bulk. Movements are precise, controlled — a body trained for efficiency rather than intimidation
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with subtle warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight braid or high knot — always secured, never loose
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (shoulder-blade length when down, habitually restrained)
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with amber flecks — sharp, observant
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium to deep brown with golden and subtle olive undertones — the natural result of Hispanic, Middle Eastern, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry blending into a unified warm complexion with depth and richness
physical_description.complexion: Strong balanced features reflecting three major lineages — prominent defined cheekbones with gentle fullness from Sub-Saharan African heritage, straight nose with subtle Mediterranean bridge definition and slight width reflecting Middle Eastern ancestry, strong jawline tapering toward a defined chin. Warm golden and olive undertones throughout create visual depth. Skin is clean and well-maintained despite living conditions. Expression defaults to neutral watchfulness
distinguishing_marks: Faint chemical burn scars along her right forearm — irregular white lines from wrist to elbow, partially concealed by long sleeves
Small tattoo on the inside of her left wrist — a molecular structure symbol rendered in black ink
Thin scar along her left temple, nearly invisible unless light catches it at certain angles
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome vocal modulator mounted at the throat — a smooth, surgical-grade implant with minimal aesthetic customization. The seam is clean and visible when her neck is exposed. No visible heat-masking hardware; thermal system is subcutaneous
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate control — minimalist, economical gestures. Sits with spine straight, feet positioned for quick exit. Eyes track people and exits instinctively. Speaks rarely and with measured cadence
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian — function over aesthetics. Favors high-necked clothing to frame the modulator. Loose tactical jacket (synthetic material, neutral gray), reinforced cargo pants with sealed pockets, steel-toed boots. Minimal jewelry — a worn watch with encrypted functions. Dresses identically whether on contract or maintaining cover; consistency is her camouflage
